title: crypto2dev: FIPS gate wiring (REQUIRE_FIPS ioctl)
description: Implement the conditional REQUIRE_FIPS enforcement. When WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_REQUIRE_FIPS is defined at build time, every new OPERATION fd must have CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_REQUIRE_FIPS called before CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_INIT, and every new KEY fd must also call REQUIRE_FIPS before KEY_IMPORT or KEY_GENERATE. Implementation: in the fd pool acquire() function, after opening or resetting a slot, call REQUIRE_FIPS if the build flag is set. In KEY fd open helpers, call REQUIRE_FIPS immediately after open(). Error from REQUIRE_FIPS (-ENOENT if no FIPS provider loaded): return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE to allow software fallback, or WC_HW_E if the caller set WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_REQUIRE_FIPS_HARD (hard fail if FIPS unavailable). Also implement wc_crypto2dev_fips_state() that reads /sys/class/misc/crypto2dev/fips_state and returns the enum value.
notes: REQUIRE_FIPS is per-fd and must be called before INIT. It cannot be called after INIT (returns -EBUSY). In the pool, a slot that was previously INIT'd without REQUIRE_FIPS cannot retroactively get FIPS enforcement — it must be recycled (close + reopen + REQUIRE_FIPS + INIT). The pool recycle logic already handles algo mismatch by close+reopen; extend it to also recycle on FIPS policy mismatch.
